summary: Frontend-only verification of the App.js -> routes/*.jsx structural refactor. Verified that the route tree compiles & resolves: app boots, unauthenticated landing renders, public login pages render, admin login + every requested admin sub-route + every role-based panel route render correctly with no redirect-to-/ loop, /kiosk renders, the catch-all redirects /this-does-not-exist -> /. Driver protected routes correctly redirect to / when unauthenticated (ProtectedRoute behavior unchanged). No new console/runtime errors introduced by the refactor; the only console errors observed are pre-existing (401 polling and the long-standing 'duplicate key' React warning on /login).

public./: OK (LandingPage rendered, title 'SB Drive — VTC & Multi-Services')

admin_authenticated./admin: OK (AdminDashboard rendered with stats: 275 utilisateurs, 33 chauffeurs, 661 courses...)

driver_routes.status: NOT FULLY EXERCISED (could not programmatically complete OTP/phone login; /chauffeur/login only exposes phone-OTP and social providers, no email/password form)
driver_routes.indirect_verification: All 5 driver paths (/chauffeur/home, /reservations, /earnings, /profile, /wallet) responded — when unauthenticated they correctly redirect to / via ProtectedRoute (expected behavior, not a regression). Routes exist in driverRoutes.jsx and compile.

client_authenticated_routes.status: NOT EXERCISED (same OTP limitation; client /login also uses phone OTP only). Routes verified to exist in clientRoutes.jsx with correct ProtectedRoute wrapping.

console_observations: Pre-existing 401 errors from background polling endpoints (unrelated to refactor)
Pre-existing React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, %s' on /login page (existed before refactor, originates inside LoginPage component)
Pre-existing Google Maps Autocomplete deprecation warning (unrelated)
action_items: OPTIONAL (pre-existing, not from refactor): Investigate duplicate-key React warning in src/pages/auth/LoginPage when rendering /login.
OPTIONAL (pre-existing): 401 noise from background API polling on unauthenticated landing — consider gating polling until user is present.

Driver and client end-to-end protected-route verification could not be performed automatically because both flows require phone-OTP; main agent can self-verify by logging in manually or by providing a non-OTP test driver credential.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean and idiomatic for React Router v6: each routes/*.jsx exports a function returning <>...<Route/></> fragments and is composed inside a single <Routes> in App.js — this works correctly (verified at runtime, no 'No routes matched' warnings observed).

pages.js central lazy() barrel is good. One observation: a few legacy exports (AdminPayout, AdminDocuments, AdminDisputes, AdminWalletRequests, AdminSettlements) are declared but not consumed by any routes/*.jsx — safe to keep but candidate for cleanup.

panelRoutes.jsx mounts /dispatcher, /dispatch, /billing, /server, /users-admin, /drivers-admin, /merchants-admin — all require role 'admin' which matches the Phase B credential note that those demo accounts use ProtectedRoute via admin role.
App.js mounts <VoiceAssistant /> only on /home for role 'user' — preserved correctly.
Catch-all is at the bottom of <Routes>, so order is correct after composition of all route groups.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the routes that could be exercised; driver/client OTP-gated routes not auto-verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone-OTP-gated flows (/login client, /chauffeur/login driver) cannot be auto-tested headlessly because /chauffeur/login only exposes phone-OTP and social providers (Apple/Google/Facebook/FaceID) — no email/password option, contrary to what one might expect. Admin login works via /admin-login email form. The structural refactor is verified intact: all 9 directly-tested route classes work, no new console errors. Pre-existing duplicate-key warning on /login predates this refactor.
